title: Artifact Graphs, Audit Logs, and Replay
subtitle: Execution should produce an artifact graph with audit logs, provenance, replay metadata, and links to claims and tests.
next_title: Runtime Adapters, Tool Permissions, and Human Approval

display.problem: The stack needs durable artifacts and replayable traces so work can be inspected, reused, tested, and improved.
display.insufficient: If outputs are not tied to inputs, tools, context, claims, and logs, later verification and improvement cannot know what happened.

mechanism.label: Freeze artifact admission envelope
mechanism.detail: Freeze an artifact admission envelope with stable… authority, rights, retention, and expiry before reuse.

mechanism.label: Content digests where policy
mechanism.detail: Compute content digests and, where policy matters… display names as mutable locations or projections.

mechanism.label: Each artifact revision exact
mechanism.detail: Bind each artifact revision to exact source… cost, and residual lineage that actually applied.

mechanism.label: Append-only superseding audit
mechanism.detail: Record append-only or superseding audit events… retirement with actor and clock boundaries.

failures: Artifact amnesia leaves useful or harmful… claim, test, owner, or residual lineage.

proof_targets: A reachable artifact lifecycle preserves exact artifact… admission without assigning support or external effects.
Missing provenance, replay, observation, cross-check, trap, attestation-limit… revocation, or consumer obligations block lifecycle progress.
The refinement preserves exact replay-packet custody… certificates, and replay validation before reality review.
